title: The Right Lease
space: the student's own namespace `students/{user}`, database `app_{user}`, fork and app slot
goal: The app's database logins are living too long: it needs credentials valid 2 minutes and never longer than 10 minutes in total. Set that up on a **new** role called `c2-app`, and get a credential from it.
constraints: in `students/{user}`, database role `c2-app` has a default TTL of 2m and a max TTL of 10m; at least one credential (lease) has been issued from `c2-app`
verify_text: in `students/{user}`: database role `c2-app` has `default_ttl` 2m and `max_ttl` 10m, and at least one lease exists under `database/creds/c2-app` (lease ids only, never the credential).
isolation: each student has their own database `app_{user}` and their own `database/` engine; the check reads only `students/{user}` (the namespace is derived from the student).
hints: TTL and max TTL are separate settings.
On the role, not on the mount.
seed: `dojo challenge start c2` creates `{user}/challenge-lease` (cloned to `~/lab/challenge-lease`) with a brief only. The student's own `database/config/app-db` from Lab 12 step 1 is the connection; the student creates `c2-app` and its credential.
answer: `dojo challenge start c2`, `export BAO_NAMESPACE=students/$USER`, `bao write database/roles/c2-app` as in Lab 12 step 2 (same `db_name` and statements) with `"default_ttl": "2m", "max_ttl": "10m"`, `bao read database/creds/c2-app`, then `dojo check c2`.
